calibrated.label: Type scale range
calibrated.why: Premium pages travel a long way between the smallest label and the display voice.

calibrated.label: Distinct type sizes
calibrated.why: Too few steps reads as a template; too many reads as unmanaged.

calibrated.label: Display size vs viewport
calibrated.why: The headline must own the fold without shouting.

calibrated.label: Display line height
calibrated.why: Tight leading is the single clearest signal of typographic intent.

calibrated.label: Display measure (ch)
calibrated.why: Headlines break on purpose; long single lines read as unconsidered.

calibrated.label: Body measure (ch)
calibrated.why: Readable prose stays inside a controlled measure.

calibrated.label: Body line height
calibrated.why: Comfortable leading for sustained reading.

calibrated.label: Weights in play
calibrated.why: A weight system, not a single default.

calibrated.label: Surface layers
calibrated.why: Depth comes from layered surfaces, not from shadows.

calibrated.label: Text tones
calibrated.why: Primary / secondary / tertiary ink instead of one grey.

calibrated.label: Hue discipline
calibrated.why: Restrained hue count keeps a page expensive-looking.

calibrated.label: Neutral temperature
calibrated.why: Pure #808080 greys are the loudest AI tell; premium neutrals carry a hue.

calibrated.label: Median text contrast
calibrated.why: Readable by default, not just at the largest sizes.

calibrated.label: Section padding
calibrated.why: Vertical breathing room separates chapters of the argument.

calibrated.label: Spacing grid conformity
calibrated.why: Spacing that lands on a scale rather than on arbitrary numbers.

calibrated.label: Container ratio
calibrated.why: Content is framed, not stretched edge to edge.

calibrated.label: Asymmetric grids
calibrated.why: Equal-width card rows everywhere is the template signature.

calibrated.label: Document height (vh)
calibrated.why: Enough argument to earn the sale, not an endless scroll.

calibrated.label: Section weight variation
calibrated.why: Sections should differ in density; uniform bands read as generated.

calibrated.label: Radius steps
calibrated.why: A radius scale, not one rounded value on everything.

calibrated.label: Shadow coverage
calibrated.why: Shadow-on-everything is the clearest generic tell.

calibrated.label: Hairline borders
calibrated.why: Structure carried by 1px rules rather than heavy chrome.

calibrated.label: Transition coverage
calibrated.why: Motion on the things you touch, not on everything.

calibrated.label: Median transition (ms)
calibrated.why: Fast enough to feel responsive, slow enough to read as intentional.

calibrated.label: Declared tokens
calibrated.why: A real design system is declared, not hard-coded.

calibrated.label: Nav links
calibrated.why: A navigable spine, not a sitemap in the header.

calibrated.label: Above-fold CTAs
calibrated.why: One primary decision, at most one alternative.

calibrated.label: Above-fold characters
calibrated.why: Enough to orient a buyer, little enough to be read.

calibrated.label: Headings on page
calibrated.why: A real argument has named parts; two headings means a stub.

calibrated.label: Uppercase micro-labels
calibrated.why: Small tracked labels are how sections announce themselves without shouting.
